Sitting on his back is the older girl with long blonde hair (R2), wearing a pink short-sleeved dress and grey tights, smiling happily. In the background, a younger blonde girl in a white top sits behind them, smiling. A wooden clothing rack with hanging dresses stands behind them. The scene is illuminated by soft, bright indoor light, creating a warm, pastel-toned atmosphere.
